name: Tally (SS)
description:
One tally group — four strokes and the fifth across them — scratched into stone: the Pit's score, which is bosses killed rather than time survived (feelers docs/pit-plan.md §6). The HUD scratches a stroke in beside the timer every time a boss dies, the results screen cuts the whole count in one stroke at a time, and a codex record lays it over `ss.icon.tablet`.

So every stroke is its own part, `stroke_1` to `stroke_5` in the order they are cut, and a consumer reveals them one at a time; a count of seven is one whole group and a second one showing `stroke_1` and `stroke_2`. Each part's origin is the end its scratch starts from — the top of a vertical, the low end of the bar — so scaling one up from nothing draws it the way a hand would. A stroke is $chitin, the amber the game already uses for what it has earned, laid over an $ink groove a unit wider all round (a `thin` stroke, under the fill): the dark scratched mark the pale cut sits in, which is also what keeps it legible on a lit floor, a dark HUD and the stone alike. Each is a little bowed and thickest just after it bites in, because a scratch is not a ruled line. No tile — it stands on whatever it is cut into.
